articles.summary: Polyphenylene sulfide earns its place among the high-performance polymers through near-total chemical inertness, in chemical handling, automotive and electrical parts.
articles.title: PPS Material Properties and Applications

articles.summary: Polyphenylene sulfide (or “PPS” for short) is a semi-crystalline engineering thermoplastic available in filament form, known for its high chemical and thermal resistance. In addition to its performance in chemical and high-temperature environments, PPS also exhibits excellent characteristics where it comes to toughness, wear resistance, and mechanical strength.
